newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan students commemorate riots with clashes.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan students commemorate riots with clashes.

text.p: Venezuelan students clashed with police on Thursday in several protests to commemorate the eighth anniversary of bloody riots in Caracas, police said.
Groups of youths as young as 11 years old threw stones and bottles in various parts of the capital throughout the day injuring at least two officers, a police spokesman said.
"It's because today is February 27th," he said, referring to the Feb. 27, 1989 riots and looting over price rises in which more than 400 people were killed, according to official figures.
In one incident on Thursday, about 30 students, their faces covered by shirts, clashed sporadically with police outside the Venezuelan Central University for several hours.
Witnesses said at least one of the protesters carried a handgun and shot at police who replied with plastic bullets and tear gas.
